notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for atomic rejection of a Join Federation Execution request that combines valid and invalid additional FOM modules. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base and valid or invalid additional FOM modules, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. It verifies that a rejected composite join does not partially add declarations or membership and that a valid follow-up join composes shared declarations without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
